subject: VPC/on-prem pricing breakdown and SOC2 evidence
messages:
From: Raj Mehta <raj.mehta@finvalor.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@finvalor.com>
Date: 2026-08-22T09:14:00-04:00
Subject: Request: VPC/on-prem pricing breakdown + SOC2 evidence

Hi Mina,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. FinValor is finalizing our private deployment shortlist and procurement needs a clear, line-item breakdown for: VPC/on-prem licensing, the recurring platform fee, and the available support tiers (S1/S2/Enterprise) with associated SLAs.

We expect an initial deployment of 8 reserved racks (~40 GPUs) ramping to 16 racks in year two. Please include:
- Annual licensing (per-pool or per-GPU) and recommended quantization/instance sizing
- Platform fee calculation (what it covers and how it’s applied)
- Support tiers and time-to-resolution targets
- Migration credits and onboarding costs
- Any minimum commitments for discounts or waived fees

Also include SOC 2 Type II evidence and audit-log retention options (we have a compliance requirement for 7-year retention for certain logs). I attached our RFP spreadsheet with requirements.

Can you send a written proposal and rate card? If possible we’d like a follow-up call the week of Aug 25 to walk the team through options.

Thanks,
Raj
Raj Mehta
Head of Infrastructure Programs, FinValor
raj.mehta@finvalor.com

Attachments: RFP_FinValor_VPC_requirements.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Raj Mehta <raj.mehta@finvalor.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@finvalor.com>
Date: 2026-08-22T13:02:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Request: VPC/on-prem pricing breakdown + SOC2 evidence

Raj — thanks for the RFP and the clear requirements. Attaching our current private deployment rate card and a short summary below to get the conversation started. Happy to run through this with your infra and procurement teams on Wed 8/26 or Thu 8/27 — what works best?

Summary (high level) — options to match your ramp:

Option 1 — Private Essentials (1-year commit)- Dedicated GPU pools (reserved): $150k per rack / year (8 GPU racks assumed)- Platform fee: 12% of committed spend (covers control plane, telemetry, backup/restore tooling, quarterly health checks)- Support: Standard (business hours, 4h response for sev1)- Migration credit: $10k one-time for 1-year commit

Option 2 — Private Production (2-year commit) — recommended for predictable throughput- Dedicated GPU pools: $140k per rack / year- Platform fee: 10% of committed spend- Support: Premium (24x7, 2h response for sev1, access to escalation path)- Migration credit: $25k one-time + 2 onboarding sessions

Option 3 — Enterprise Private (3-year commit) — for regulated teams / SLAs- Dedicated GPU pools: $125k per rack / year- Platform fee: 8% of committed spend- Support: Enterprise (named CSM, quarterly SLO reviews, white-glove onboarding)- Migration credit: $50k + on-site technical workshop (if needed)

Other notes:
- We can amortize the platform fee across committed spend or invoice as a line item — most customers prefer to show it as a percent of committed spend for clarity.
- SOC2 evidence: attaching a snapshot (SOC2_snapshot.pdf) and we can provide auditor contact under an NDA for deeper review.
- Audit logs: we support 1–7 year retention options; longer retention is an add-on to storage pricing (we can propose an archival rate).
- Pilot: we can run a 90-day pilot on a reduced-rate basis; pilot outputs are credited toward full commit if converted within 90 days.

Attachments: Redwood_VPC_Ratecard_Q3.pdf, SOC2_snapshot.pdf

Quick ask: what annual ARR commitment are you targeting? That will determine which pricing band makes the most sense.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Head of Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0172

Subject: Re: Request: VPC/on-prem pricing breakdown + SOC2 evidence

Mina — appreciate the clear options and the SOC2 snapshot. A few follow-ups from procurement and compliance:

1) Platform fee — competitor decks are showing zero platform fee for year 1 in exchange for a multi-year commit. Can Redwood offer a platform fee waiver or credit for year one if we sign a multi-year agreement?

2) Licensing discount — procurement is asking for a 25% discount on rack pricing for an initial order if we commit to a 2-year purchase order.

3) Audit logging — we need explicit confirmation that audit logs for admin actions and access will be retained for 7 years at rest, and that log export to our S3 is supported.

4) Pilot — procurement prefers a short (60–90 day) pilot with a fixed not-to-exceed cost that would be credited if we move to a full commit.

If Redwood can provide a packaged counter that includes a platform-fee concession and stronger migration credits, we’ll prioritize Redwood in our short-list. SOC2 evidence looks reasonable so far — our security team may ask for deeper artifacts under NDA.

Let’s plan a short call tomorrow (8/23) 10–11am ET to go through specifics.

—Raj

Attachments: none

Subject: Fwd: VPC/on-prem pricing breakdown + SOC2 evidence — FinValor counter and ask for approval

Team — forwarding FinValor's counter (below). Procurement is pushing for: platform fee waiver year 1, 25% off rack pricing for 2-year commit, 7-year log retention, and a 60–90 day pilot credit.

My read and proposed counter-offer to keep economics reasonable and protect margin:

Proposed commercial counter (we can present 8/23 10:30am ET):
- Pricing banding: 16-rack target (year 2) as anchor.
- License: 15% discount off Option 2 rack price if they commit to a 24-month purchase order ($140k baseline -> $119k per rack/yr).
- Platform fee: offer a 50% credit on platform fee for year 1 (effectively platform fee ~5% year 1, 10% thereafter) OR full waiver year 1 if they commit to $500k ARR minimum in Year 1 (finance to confirm threshold).
- Migration/onboarding credit: $50k credit that applies on conversion from pilot; pilot NTE fee reduced to ~$30k for 60–90 day POC and credited on conversion.
- Support: include Premium support for first 12 months, then revert to Standard unless they upgrade.
- Audit logs: commit to 7-year retention with export to their S3; archival storage billed separately at our archival rate (low single-digit $/GB/mo) — compliance can sign NDA for log access details.

Risk & approvals needed:
- If we waive platform fee entirely in year 1 we should require minimum ARR or committed racks (finance approval).
- Larger migration credit requires CRO approval if > $40k.

Related artifacts to share on call: Redwood_VPC_Ratecard_Q3.pdf, SOC2_snapshot.pdf, proposed SOW template (we can draft). HubSpot deal: HS-20345.

Please confirm: Vivek — do you approve the 50% platform-fee credit approach as the default negotiating position (finance will set the exact ARR floor)? Monica — can you draft a short commercial term sheet and updated SOW that encodes the pilot credit and migration credit?

Thanks — I’ll be on the call with Raj and Elena at 10:30am ET if we can lock that.

Best,
Mina
